usageNotes: Use this to inspect the current state of a registered ACME account on Proxmox Datacenter Manager, including its contact email, status (valid/deactivated/revoked), and the ACME directory it was registered with. Requires System.Modify on /system/certificates — the same privilege needed to manage certificates. Check the returned account.status field before attempting any certificate order; a non-'valid' status means the account cannot be used for issuance.

examples.summary: Fetch details for the default ACME account

tips: Account names must start with an alphanumeric or underscore character and may contain dots, dashes, and underscores (pattern: /^(?:[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9.\-_]*)$/).
The 'directory' field in the response identifies whether the account is registered with Let's Encrypt production, Let's Encrypt staging, or a custom ACME CA.
If account.status is 'deactivated' or 'revoked', certificate renewals will fail silently until the account is replaced or re-registered.
The 'location' URL is the account's canonical URL at the ACME provider and can be used to verify account identity independently.
